headline: Fronts Stir Along the War Line
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the struggle concentrated in six unsettled sectors, with Weathered Expanse still the busiest ground despite easing to 49 base events in the past day. Nine events came in the newest two-hour watch, and its holdings remain divided among three Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral bases. Nevish Line has quickened to 33 events, including two recent actions, while its balance now reads six Warden and two Colonial bases. Linn Mercy has risen sharply to 32 events, four in the latest watch, amid accelerating casualty traffic; ten Colonial bases and one neutral remain listed. Marban Hollow records 30 events, three in six hours but none in the last two, with four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral holdings. Mooring County has cooled slightly to 22 events, though one arrived recently, around eleven Warden and one Colonial bases. Kuura Strand is quieter at seven daily events, all outside the latest two-hour window, but its recent casualty and enlistment rates are climbing. Elsewhere, Callahan’s Passage and Stonecradle report heavy fighting without comparable base-event activity.
